description: If \(e,h\) give a bounded allowance for the characteristic function of \(A\) under \(B\), the specified prefix scheme has bound \(h(x)\) and returns one exactly when the ordinary finite checker at the supplied word, allowance \(h(x)\), index \(e\) and input \(x\) returns code two. It presents \(A\le_{\mathrm{tt}}B\), including failure or non-Boolean outputs at other words.
